title: Best Radar Detectors of 2026: Expert Reviews & Buyer's Guide
snippet:
The Escort Redline 360c is a top pick for a long range and easy to use radar detector, especially for your everyday driver. It’s a long range detector with arrows, excellent false alert filtering, and some of the best hands-free automation. It ticks nearly every box you could want in terms of features and capabilities. [...] + Uniden: Laser updates released for flagship models in May, Jun, & Sept ’26, plus new features added like Ka Blocks. In Aug ’26, Uniden discontinued the R8 and the R4.
  + Escort: Hotfix in Jun ’26 for the Redline 360c, Redline Ci 360c, Max 360c Mk II, and Max 360 Mk II to improve communication with third-party vehicle integration systems. In May ’26, ALP officially added integration with Escort’s M14 radar antennas from the Redline Ci. [...] ### Uniden R8w

Uniden R8wIf you’re looking for a long range radar detector that excels against all types of police radar, has GPS built-in, decent false alert filtering, arrows, a large display, photo radar detection, and a variety of third-party app options purchase the Uniden R8w.

 ### Escort Redline 360c

Escort Redline 360cFor the everyday driver wanting a high end yet simpler experience, purchase the Escort Redline 360c.
